name: Parabola Cannon
raw_text:
Arrow/Bowgun/Bow only Type Active, Physical skill Element Weapon Dependent MP 400 $result_string .= sprintf("Aggro %s", $row['aggro_text']); Combo start Yes Combo middle Yes Range 24 Description Attacks by firing a projectile in a parabolic trajectory. It's an AoE attack, and the farther the projectile is from the target, the faster it travels. Low chance to inflict [Silence]. Bow [Get the same effect when used with a Bowgun] Hold an arrow key to perform a roll when the skill is activated. When it hits or reaches the target, it becomes a trap and activates 1 second later. The trap will greatly increase the chance to inflict [Silence]. Extras Show more...
